subject: NeonApps hosted pricing — token economics & surge capacity next steps

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: NeonApps hosted pricing discovery call follow-up

Thanks for the recap earlier today. Quick answers so we can align to numbers before the exec sync:

- Expected steady-state monthly generation tokens: 120M–160M (user messages + system prompts).
- Peak TPS for synchronous chat flows: ~35 TPS (15–20s sustained bursts during US morning window).
- Average tokens per API call: ~850 (mix of short & long responses).
- Target commercial metric: looking to stay around $0.75–$1.25 / 1M tokens given our current vendor comps — we're flexible if Redwood shows latency/cost tradeoff.

Questions for you: can Redwood support prefix caching across our multi-tenant customers so the effective unit cost drops for repeated prompts? Also want to see a 3-month dollars run-rate at 140M tokens/month with the surge profile.

Cheers,
Ari
Ari Bhandari
CTO, NeonApps

Ari — great conversation this morning. Below is a concise recap + asks so we can produce a hosted pricing sketch and SOW draft: 

Recap (from call):
- Use case: in-product conversational assistant (support + recommendations) + nightly batch enrichment for profiles.
- Expected monthly generation tokens (estimate): you stated a range — we captured 120M to 160M.
- Peak TPS: ~35 TPS with short ~15–20s sustained windows (morning US business hours).
- Avg token per call: ~850 (we'll treat as baseline for costing).
- Latency SLO target: p95 < 350ms where possible for interactive flows.

Asks / next data points we need from NeonApps: 
1) Confirm a single representative week of traffic (CSV) or attach QPS/requests-per-minute sample so we can validate batching assumptions.
2) Confirm target $/1M (ballpark). Your note about $0.75–$1.25 is helpful — we'll model both.
3) Any security/compliance blockers for hosted (we support private options if required).

What we'll deliver by EOD Wed: 
- Hosted pricing sketch (dollars per month at 120/140/160M) and per-1M metrics.
- A short SOW draft and suggested commit tiers (monthly & 12-month).
- Notes on caching/quantization options to improve unit economics.

I'll hand to Marissa (copied) to produce the pricing spreadsheet; Monica will propose the SOW template.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ari Bhandari <ari@neonapps.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-28T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood hosted pricing sketch (baseline + surge)
Attachments: Redwood-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx, SOW-draft-NeonApps.pdf

Ari — attaching the sketch and a very short SOW template. Highlights below (baseline assumptions use avg 850 tokens / call):

Model A — conservative (120M/mo)
- Effective tokens/month: 120,000,000
- Unit price modeled: $1.10 / 1M tokens
- Monthly list: $132.00 (per 1M) -> $132,000 monthly estimate
- Peak handling: supports 40 TPS sustained with autoscaling buffer in hosted pool

Model B — commit-friendly (140M/mo)
- Unit price modeled: $0.95 / 1M tokens (requires 6-month soft commit)
- Monthly: $133.00 per 1M -> $133,000 monthly estimate (discount vs on-demand)

Model C — aggressive (160M/mo)
- Unit price modeled: $0.80 / 1M tokens (12-month committed)
- Monthly: $128.00 per 1M -> $128,000 monthly estimate

Notes: the math above includes estimated savings from prefix/KV caching for repeated prompt templates (~10% effective token reduction in baseline). If NeonApps can share sample prompt repetition rates, we can refine. The pricing-sheet has line-item assumptions for GPU attach time, tokenization overhead, and streaming vs non-streaming billing.

Security note: hosted environment supports customer KMS integration; if you require VPC/private deployment we can convert the SOW.

Next steps I propose:
1) NeonApps confirm which model they prefer to illustrate to finance (A/B/C).
2) Share a short traffic sample (anonymized) we can run through our batching simulator.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with our infra lead (Monica) to validate p95 latency under your payload sizes.

I'll update the spreadsheet with a 3-month dollars run-rate for the 140M scenario once we get your confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales — Hosted Solutions
Redwood Inference
